main_body: Farm ground patch: golden wheat rows on top, a green crop band, then tilled soil rows with sprouts. It is flat terrain with no standing volume.
top_band: none: the column scan shows stacked ground bands (wheat, crops, soil), not a top surface over a front face
evidence: The kind is terrain, a ground autotile block laid out as bands of wheat, crops and furrowed soil. The 3/4 contract for standing objects does not apply, and there is no standing object, receding side face, or rim/lid to fail. Nothing is drawn as a vertical elevation that should show a top. Accepted as terrain.

style.evidence: The wheat band uses about 5 steps (pale highlight, yellow, orange-gold, brown, dark brown) with per-grain speckle. The crop band has 3-4 greens with leaf clumps, and the soil has 4-5 browns with clods and sprouts. Outlines are tinted dark brown or dark green (0% neutral edge pixels), with no sticker look. Flat-fill coverage is 0%. Median 13 colours per tile is above the paving reference (7) but below the grass reference (26), and total distinct colours (24) are well below the grass reference (80). Overall it is slightly less dense than the grass but still textured and structured, so it is acceptable beside the references.
